name: tab-showcase
description: Tabbed before/after panel: an asset record card beside the intelligence it gains, with an AI insight and a closing definition band. Tabs are CSS-only radio inputs. Live: .apx-bat on /asset-intelligence-platform/.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the heading. Also names the section for assistive tech.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

track_label_alt.description: Alt text for the tracking card's label image.

track_connector.description: Connector line image beside the tracking card.

intel_label_alt.description: Alt text for the intelligence card's label image.

intel_connector.description: Connector line image beside the intelligence card.

panels.description: One per tab. Each: slot (fire, police), tab_prefix, tab_label, asset {image, image_alt, name, tag, rows: [{label, value, icon, tone (ok paints the value teal with a dot)}]}, features [{title, note, chip, tone (due, over, ok, info), icon}], insight {title, body, note, cta_label, cta_url, confidence, spark (sparkle image in the corner)}.

definition_orb.description: Orb image in the closing band.

definition_orb_alt.description: Alt text for the orb. Empty marks the orb decorative.
